name: Ultranationalism
summary: An extreme form of nationalism that promotes the interest of one nation above all others. The defining sources describe xenophobic disdain of other nations, authoritarian rule verging on totalitarianism around a charismatic leader, hostility to immigrants and minorities, militarism, tariffs and rejection of pluralist representative government.
scope: The extreme form of nationalism as the defining sources describe it: EBSCO's overview (authoritarianism, an end to immigration, oppression or expulsion of minorities, strict tariffs, militarism, tight business controls, propaganda), Bugajski and Griffin as quoted by the ECPS glossary (xenophobic disdain of other nations, authoritarian arrangements verging on totalitarianism, a charismatic leader, mythicized national greatness, rejection of pluralist representative government) and Skya's study of its Shinto form. Fascist and Japanese texts are other subjects' sources and answer nothing here unless a defining source ties them to it; where the sources state nothing, answers are null.
